Intro: Psh it's me, dear. Let's not act suspicious, alright? Svetka is tightening her control of these streets. Leaving Repose was difficult enough for this.
That recent bombing has got them all paranoid. The soldiers are even questioning prostitutes like us about the revolution movement.
Just keeping the brothel safe is difficult enough. I haven't been able to watch over Ivan and Eve lately. I hope they are okay.
I can't wait for this to all be over. We have suffered long enough under tyrants. Soon, we can take our revenge. Do you have the message, dear?
Success: Thank you, dear. When the time comes, I hope you join in the efforts of the Revolution. We would appreciate your assistance.
Fail: Thank you, dear. When the time comes, I hope you join in the efforts of the Revolution. We would appreciate your assistance.
Reject: No…you can't! If I'm gone, who will protect Repose!? I thought I could trust you!
